atoms.text: Over the past few thousand years, the way humans get food has changed quite a lot. These changes have had impacts on the human diet too. For example, in the past, hunter-gatherers ate whatever they could find. Nowadays, many people can more freely choose what they want to eat.

There are many different types of diets. For example, vegetarians choose not to eat meat. Instead, they eat foods like vegetables, fruit, nuts, grains or beans. Some people go a step further and avoid eating anything that comes from animals. That means they also refuse to eat eggs, honey, cheese, milk or butter. This type of diet is called veganism.
